H1, H2, then another H1 creates two sibling top-level groups

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<h1>Chapter One</h1><h2>Section A</h2><p>Section A content.</p><h1>Chapter Two</h1><h2>Section B</h2><p>Section B content.</p>", "{\"include_document_structure\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
